# AI service artwork provenance

`api-assets.json` records the actual 16 API identity marks and three distinct
Codex/Claude/Copilot product marks rendered by the shared registry, their
immutable source/version references and rendered SHA-256.
SVG Logos assets are installed via `@iconify-icons/logos@2.0.1` (CC0-1.0);
their exact package module SHA-256 is recorded too. Original collection:
https://github.com/gilbarbara/logos .

OpenRouter's existing path comes from Simple Icons (CC0-1.0). Six service SVGs
were byte-compared (ignoring a trailing newline) with Lobe Icons at revision
ab8cbcc6ce806b923c547628132957c8a8b61509. Its MIT copyright/license is retained
at `public/brand/services/LOBE-ICONS-LICENSE.txt`.

These notices concern distributed files. Product names and marks remain with
their owners, and no endorsement or separate trademark permission is claimed.
Review vendor brand guidelines before public marketing or co-branding. Full
identity and source limitations: `docs/ai-provider-branding.md`.
